body:
Build brief. All living and non-living models picked by Karolis (31 Oct).
VET CLINIC: clinic, inside, exam table, big-pet platform, scale, shelf, booking desk, seats, coffee table, treat; 4 vets + lobby nurse. Fits rules-vet-visit. When the clinic is in the game, sickness (stage 2) is switched on.
BIG-NEEDS PETS (rules-big-needs-pets): monkey and seal = animal license level 1 + pet yard L3 + their home; bear = license level 3 + yard L3 + cave; snake = license level 1 + glass tank, no yard level. Pet shop shows them locked ('🔒 Pet yard level 3', '🔒 Animal license 3' ...); Ms. Paws names the first missing thing in this order: Pet care level, pet yard level, home, license. Bear and seal wait outside buildings (they do come into the vet station); monkey and snake follow everywhere. Never called 'exotic'.
ANIMAL LICENSE (rules-animal-license, approved): earned from Pet Show top-3 finishes plus healthy weeks, counted from the update (stage 5). So big pets can only be bought once stage 5 is live.
Model pack: tools/model-pack/ in the book. Today's pets redrawn to the picked models.
MOVES: moves-pet-wait-outside (bear and seal by the door), moves-vet-bigpets (big-pet table), moves-pet-seal-flippers.
SCREENS: screens-shop-locks, screens-snake-tank.
MODELS: living pack v3 (book tools/living-pack/, 57 items, all picked) + non-living model pack (tools/model-pack/).
PLACEMENTS: vet clinic spot in claude/pfu-placements.json.
FAVOURITE TOYS (rules-pet-brain-details): monkey frisbee, seal ball, bear squeaky toy, snake toy mouse (PET_TOY in js/01-models.js has none for new pets: the Play button would break). A big-needs pet's home counts as its toy at home.
PRICES (economy-pfu-prices, approved): normal pets 200; monkey, seal, bear, snake 400. Homes: climbing tree 400, glass tank 400, pond 700, cave den 700, dog house 180. Beds 80 / 100 / 120; food bowl 30, water bowl 30, pet toy box 60. Every pet toy 20 (feather toy 25); today's toys go up to 20, owned toys stay. Training gear 150-300 (list in economy-pfu-prices). Pet accessories 40 each. Farm animals and horses not for sale.
NEW PET SHOP (model-petshop-new, approved): 3 open floors as one room, 14 x 10, Map spot x 11..25, z 10.6..20.6. Game work: step height per staircase, stair zones, blockers for handrails and the open-middle railing, pet-follow path on the stairs, a camera that follows 3 floors without hitting slabs (moves-petshop-stairs, moves-petshop-spots).
WAITING FOR KAROLIS: objects-petshop-fixes (stairs: deeper landing or shorter handrail; snake: wider hide or sleeps stretched); then Objects fixes the models.
NEW PETS PLAY: favourite toy play (approved): monkey frisbee, seal ball, bear squeaky toy, snake toy mouse; frisbee + mouse models: Karolis's pick (model-toys-frisbee-mouse). Snake sleeps coiled. Objects fixes still open: terrarium branch/rock out of the hide, open-top snake basket, hamster maze scale.
